# `m.reference.tickers`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every ticker Massive supports, across asset classes, with its listing details.

```python
m.reference.tickers(symbols=None, *, market=None, ticker_type=None, exchange=None, cusip=None, cik=None, as_of=None, active=True, search=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol` |
| `sort` | `ticker`, `name`, `market`, `locale`, `primary_exchange`, `type`, `currency_symbol`, `currency_name`, `base_currency_symbol`, `base_currency_name`, `cik`, `composite_figi`, `share_class_figi`, `last_updated_utc`, `delisted_utc` |
| `filters` | `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `symbols` | Tickers of any classes; None for every ticker (`dm.ALL` is refused). | Massive's ticker for each symbol, spelled exactly as Massive spells it: `AAPL` or `BRK.B` for a stock, `O:SPY271217C00700000` (the OCC code) for an option, `I:SPX` for an index, `C:EURUSD` for a forex pair, `X:BTCUSD` for a crypto pair, and `ESZ6` for a future. Pass one symbol as text, several as a list, or a table with a `Symbol` column. A live table is followed: each symbol you add is read, and the rows of each one you delete leave the table. `dm.ALL` reads every symbol, and leaving the argument out reads every record with no filter by symbol, where this dataset takes them. A misspelled symbol in text or a list raises `ValueError` at the call; a misspelled row of a table is skipped and logged, and the table keeps running. `dm.canonical_symbol` converts other spellings to Massive's. A record that lists several symbols, such as a news article, appears once for each symbol you named that it lists. |
| `market` | The market to list; None for every market. |  |
| `ticker_type` | The type, such as `dm.TickerType.CS` (`ticker_types()` lists them), sent as the wire parameter `type`; None for every type. |  |
| `exchange` | The primary exchange's MIC, such as `"XNAS"`; None for every exchange. |  |
| `cusip` | The CUSIP to look up; None for any. |  |
| `cik` | The SEC Central Index Key to look up; None for any. |  |
| `as_of` | The day the listing is as of, sent as `date`; None for today. | The day to read the data as it stood on, as text such as `"2025-06-02"`, a Python `date`, or a Deephaven `LocalDate`. Leave it out for today's state. How far back you can go depends on your plan; this page's plan table says how much history each plan holds. |
| `active` | True (the default) lists tickers traded on `as_of`; False lists delisted ones. |  |
| `search` | Text matched against the ticker and the company name; None for no search. |  |
| `sort` | The field to sort by. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | Per ticker when tickers are named, else in total. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | All Tickers (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Updated as needed, 2 years; Updated hourly, 2 years |
| Currencies Starter | Updated as needed, All history; Updated hourly, All history |
| Currencies Business | Updated as needed, All history; Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Basic | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Starter | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Advanced | Updated hourly, All history |
| Indices Business | Updated hourly, All history |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `Active` | boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. | REST |
| `BaseCurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST |
| `BaseCurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). | REST |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST |
| `CurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. | REST |
| `LastUpdatedUtc` | Instant | The information is accurate up to this time. | REST |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. | REST |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. | REST |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. | REST |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. | REST |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
